data.content_ref: inline:Introduce a higher-order attack graph where attack edges are reified as nodes, and the skeptical fixpoint is extended to these attack-nodes. This allows attacks on attacks, enabling a node to be reinstated when all its attackers are themselves attacked. To preserve determinism and polynomial cost, we restrict the order to at most 2 and define a monotone operator on the extended graph. Criticism: this may break the derived property of reinstatement unless the operator is carefully designed; also the graph size grows quadratically, potentially affecting polynomial bounds.
